output.reason: The release note [ev-d3b064742968] is only a title, but the linked PR [ev-070f512a01a7] fills in what it leaves out. It is labelled release/breaking-behavior-change. It says registry defaulting for package references is dropped and strict validation is enforced, so package images must name both a registry and a tag. The PR's changed files [ev-fe231b368663] show the subject is the package reference: they touch apis/pkg/v1/package_types.go, the Provider, Configuration and Function CRDs, and the package meta types for dependencies. Exposed environments are those using package references with no explicit registry, and for them the reference no longer resolves to a default registry and fails strict validation. One caveat: the PR leaves admission-time validation of spec.package to later work, so the exact failure point is not shown.
